summary: Guild Wars entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Guild Wars 2
entries.definitive_edition: Current official Windows PC live-service client with owned expansions

primary.why: Guild Wars 2 is a live MMORPG with many expansions and seasonal releases, so the archive target is the current PC client plus account/expansion/story state. Steam is an alternate official access path, but ArenaNet account and expansion ownership need to be logged.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official Windows client through ArenaNet or Steam. Record account type, server/region, character/profession, expansion ownership, story step, build/date, graphics settings, and active event or Living World state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Archive by date, account, region, expansion ownership, story progress, and launcher route.
